why: P4-F5 plant (FP3-5): R-3's form for a one-subject visual spec, moved out of tests-visual/ into its unit's slot as *.visual.ts. Playwright collects tests-visual/**/*.spec.ts (testDir ".", testMatch "*.spec.ts"), so the moved spec silently leaves the program. The pass-3 graph does not read testDir/testMatch and applies the move; the P4 graph carries the program as edges, so the image check refuses it.
